dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.lead: Routes underway and about to leave, and those from the last seven days
dispatch.emptyManage: No dispatches. Create one: choose a planned route or some standalone destinations, and the vehicle that takes them.
dispatch.needStops: Choose a planned route or add at least one destination.
dispatch.needVehicle: Choose the vehicle that takes the route.
dispatch.marking: Tap the map where each destination goes
dispatch.vehicle: Vehicle <muted>· from the closest to the first destination to the farthest, in a straight line</muted>
dispatch.pickFirst: First choose what is dispatched: that shows which vehicle is closest.
dispatch.name: Dispatch name (optional)
dispatch.driverLinkLead: With it, the driver sees their stops on their phone, marks each delivery and takes the photo and the signature. No account needed. Creating a new one disables the previous one.
dispatch.confirmDelete: The dispatch and its proofs of delivery will be deleted. This can't be undone.

stop.trackTitle: Link for whoever is waiting for this delivery

plans.title: Planned routes
plans.note: The path, the stops and the schedule of each recurring route
plans.emptyManage: No routes yet. Plan one with its stops; then dispatch it to a vehicle in a couple of taps.
plans.needStop: A route has at least one stop.
plans.toleranceRange: The tolerance goes from 30 to 2,000 meters.
plans.pathPoints: The path needs at least two points. Keep marking, or delete it.
plans.minutes: The minutes of “{{name}}” are whole numbers.
plans.toleranceHint: Farther from the path than this, it notifies the deviation.
plans.hintStop: Tap the map where each stop goes.
plans.hintLine: Tap the map point by point, following the streets it should take.
plans.hintWithPath: With a path: if a vehicle strays from it farther than the tolerance, it notifies the deviation.
plans.hintNoPath: Without a path, the route is just its list of stops and doesn't notify deviations.
plans.stopsLabel: Stops, in order <muted>· “min” is the minutes after departure when arrival is expected</muted>

pois.title: Points of interest
pois.note: Customers, warehouses, branches and the other places your vehicles visit
pois.emptyManage: No places yet. Add your customers and warehouses: then you can choose them as stops without marking them on the map again.
pois.needPoint: Mark the place on the map, or paste its coordinates.
pois.radiusRange: The radius goes from 20 to 2,000 meters.
pois.where: Where it is: tap the map to mark it
pois.coordsHint: You can also paste them, as a map gives them when copying a point.
pois.radiusHint: Within that distance it counts as “at the place”.
pois.fromVehicle: Or put it where a vehicle is now
